description: Lines that serve an ÖBB station according to the plan but that HAFAS does not show at the moment, mostly because of construction. Used only by the report-only line check (stage 3, scripts/check_feed_lines.py). An entry applies up to and including 'until'; null means the end is open. Expired entries are ignored and logged so they get reviewed.

stations.name: Wien Mitte-Landstraße
stations.reason: ÖBB-Infrastruktur, SNNB 2027 annex 2.5.1 (2026-06-02): Wien Praterstern – Wien Hbf closed, construction phase 7 from 2026-12-13, phases 8/9 until 2027-10-29 20:00 (B-74918, B-65391); ÖBB folder 'Sperren S-Bahn Wien Stammstrecke 2026/27' (May 2026): main closure Wien Hbf/St. Marx – Wien Praterstern 2026-09-07 to end of October 2027, S-Bahn and REX trains end at Praterstern or Wien Hbf/St. Marx. REX1 and REX3 stop on both sides of the closure even at small stations (Traisengasse, Matzleinsdorfer Platz); REX7 stops at St. Marx.

See Wien Mitte-Landstraße for REX1, REX3 and REX7.

stations.reason: ÖBB-Infrastruktur, SNNB 2027 annex 2.5.1 (2026-06-02): Wien Praterstern – Wien Hbf closed, construction phase 7 from 2026-12-13, phases 8/9 until 2027-10-29 20:00 (B-74918, B-65391); ÖBB folder 'Sperren S-Bahn Wien Stammstrecke 2026/27' (May 2026): main closure Wien Hbf/St. Marx – Wien Praterstern 2026-09-07 to end of October 2027, S-Bahn and REX trains end at Praterstern or Wien Hbf/St. Marx. stations.name: Wien Hütteldorf
stations.reason: Verbindungsbahn: S80 cancelled between Wien Hütteldorf and Wien Meidling from 2026-09-07 to the end of 2027, rail replacement buses every 15 minutes (ÖBB folder, May 2026); SNNB 2027 annex 2.5.1: 'Attraktivierung Verbindungsbahn Phase 2+3' 2026-12-13 to 2027-12-09 (B-92487).

stations.name: Wien Speising
stations.reason: Verbindungsbahn: S80 cancelled between Wien Hütteldorf and Wien Meidling until the end of 2027; the rail replacement buses stop at Hietzinger Hauptstraße and Wien Speising (ÖBB folder, May 2026; SNNB 2027 annex 2.5.1, B-92487 until 2027-12-09). stations.name: Himberg
stations.reason: Station rebuild: ÖBB Rahmenplan 2027–2032 lists 'Bahnhof Himberg (NÖ) Inbetriebnahme 2026'. HAFAS shows no departures at either stop (sample dates 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-03); the neighbours Lanzendorf-Rannersdorf and Gramatneusiedl have the S60, and the station lies on the Ostbahn (line 11801). Review at the timetable change.
